clock_creation: one clock immediately before first acquisition; all later phases consume that file/digest and cannot refresh start/deadline
clock_serialization: UTF8 JSON sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, one trailing newline
confirmation: a separate runtime clock starts only after verified development pass; both static stage designs are registered before either acquisition
receipt_binding: acquisition final and all subsequent phase receipts preserve static stage_manifest_sha256 and runtime stage_clock_digest separately
runtime_digest: stage_clock_digest is SHA256 of actual write-once clock file bytes; never a reserialized object or a self-including digest
static_manifest_binding: registration.stage_manifest_sha256[stage] is SHA256 of actual committed static manifest file bytes
static_manifest_files_namespace: files keys are EXP077-relative owned design/code/schema filenames; candidate_source_pins keys are separately repository-relative reused dependencies. Neither map contains the static manifest itself.
